title: 🔮 Anthropic’s S-1 in charts
text: 🔮 Anthropic’s S-1 in seven charts - by Azeem Azhar Exponential View Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / Preview 57 1 7 🔮 Anthropic’s S-1 in charts Anthropic’s S-1 should finally address the elephant in the room: is AI real? Azeem Azhar Oct 27, 2026 ∙ Paid 57 1 7 Share I went live on Substack earlier today to discuss Anthropic’s S-1. Watch the video and read the email for my takeaways. Anthropic’s S-1 should finally address the elephant in the room: is AI real? The S-1 clearly shows that Anthropic is no longer a lab. It is a business with satisfied customers, cash flow, and a war chest. It doesn’t answer whether the firm can maintain the growth rate it needs to pay for the compute it has promised to buy. The lab has become a business, and it looks like it can become reliably profitable. Growth remains very high but is slowing. New models seem key to igniting growth, with more than 80% of current revenue coming from models six months old or less. The company might slip into a marginal loss in Q3 because of payments to its foundation. We ran a detailed analysis at AI Investment Brief, covering six key questions across 39 charts. For EV members, I want to focus on what this filing reveals about the AI transition: where demand is real, how the economics are changing, and what could constrain the next phase of growth. Here’s my read on the key findings. If you’d like to dig into Anthropic’s finances in more detail, our AI Investment Brief analysis is for you.
